EmailTemplate.name: QTP-Employee Mid Year Benefit Change
EmailTemplate.subject: Employee Mid Year Benefit Change
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Client,
Employees can make changes to their Insperity Group Health Plan coverage during their annual open enrollment period. If no changes are made during open enrollment, the employee’s current election — including an election of no coverage — will carry over to the next coverage period. If a coverage option is discontinued and no new election is made, employees will be moved to the closest comparable option at the new rates for their coverage tier.
Changes Outside Open Enrollment
After open enrollment ends, employees may only change their elections if they experience a Qualifying Life Event (QLE). Employees have 60 days from the event date to request a change.
Examples of Qualifying Life Events include:
• Marriage, divorce, or legal separation • Beginning or ending a domestic partnership • Birth, adoption, or placement for adoption • Death of a dependent • Change in dependent or employee eligibility under another group health plan • Court order requiring coverage (QMCSO) • Change in residence that affects eligibility • Gaining or losing eligibility for Medicare, Medicaid, or CHIP • Enrollment in Marketplace coverage • Reduction in hours (less than 30 per week) with enrollment in other coverage • Other events permitted by the Plan
Important:
• Enrollments and additions (e.g., adding a spouse or newborn) are generally retroactive to the event date if requested within 60 days. • Terminations are usually prospective (effective when the request is submitted), except for death, divorce, or domestic partnership termination, which remain retroactive.
